EmployeeIdMapping.description: A mapping between a ComboHR employee and a client partner's own identification code, allowing the client partner to reference employees using their own system's IDs.

id.description: Partner-scoped unique identifier for this employee ID mapping

client_partner_id.description: Partner-scoped unique identifier of the associated client partner

client_partner_name.description: Name of the associated client partner

identification_code.description: The external identification code used by the client partner to reference this employee

created_at.description: Timestamp when this mapping was created

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this mapping was last updated

Location.description: A workplace location accessible to the partner, containing one or more teams.

id.description: Partner-scoped unique identifier for this location

account_id.description: Partner-scoped unique identifier for the account owning this location

partner_id.description: Alias for id — the partner-scoped identifier

teams.description: List of teams within this location. Returns an empty array if the location has only one team.

Team.description: A team within a location, grouping employees for scheduling and reporting purposes.

id.description: Partner-scoped unique identifier for this team

PastContractsResponse.description: Paginated response for the ended contracts endpoint.

contracts.description: List of ended contracts (last permanent amendment or original contract)

has_next_page.description: Whether there is at least one more page of results

Contract.description: An employee contract record, including personal details, contract terms, and payroll information. Contracts and amendments share the same structure, with original_contract_id identifying the original contract in the lineage.

id.description: Partner-scoped unique identifier of the contract

original_contract_id.description: Partner-scoped identifier of the original contract in the contract lineage. This field may be populated for both original contracts and amendments; for original contracts, it is often equal to the contract's own id.

firstname.description: First name of the employee (from membership, not versioned)

lastname.description: Last name of the employee (from membership, not versioned)

birth_name.description: Birth (maiden) name of the employee (not versioned)

email.description: Email address of the employee (not versioned)

mobile_phone.description: Mobile phone number of the employee (not versioned)

fixed_line_phone.description: Fixed line phone number of the employee (not versioned)

social_security_number.description: Social security number of the employee (not versioned)

citizenship.description: Citizenship / nationality of the employee (not versioned)

street_address.description: Street address of the employee (not versioned)

zip.description: Postal/ZIP code of the employee's address (not versioned)

city.description: City of the employee's address (not versioned)

country_of_residence.description: Country of residence of the employee (not versioned)

role.description: Role of the employee within the account (not versioned)

contract_type.description: Type of contract. One of: CDI, CDD, apprentissage, interim, seasonal, intern, extra, executive_officer_self_employed, executive_officer_as_employee

working_days_in_week.description: Number of working days per week

function.description: Job title / function of the employee

location_id.description: Partner-scoped unique identifier for the location this contract is attached to

start_date.description: Start date of the contract (or amendment period)

end_date.description: End date of the contract (or amendment period). Null for open-ended contracts or permanent amendments.

hourly_gross_rate.description: Computed hourly cost including employer social charges

monthly_gross_salary.description: Monthly gross salary stored on the contract

hourly_gross_salary.description: Hourly gross salary stored on the contract

daily_worker.description: Whether the employee is on a forfait jour contract (daily rate, not tracking hours)

contract_end_reason.description: Reason for contract termination. Null if the contract has not ended or no reason was specified. One of: automatic_termination_art50, childcare_leave, collaborator_death, collective_termination, conditions_modification, contract_change, contract_change_to_cdi, conventional_termination, disciplinary_termination, discontinuous_work_end, dismissal, dismissal_due_to_closure, dismissal_due_to_non_work_inaptitude, dismissal_due_to_work_inaptitude, early_termination_by_employee, early_termination_by_employer, early_termination_due_to_closure, early_termination_due_to_inaptitude, early_termination_for_gross_misconduct, early_termination_for_serious_misconduct, economic_dismissal, end_of_activity, end_of_employer_relationship, end_of_fixed_term_contract, end_of_temporary_disability, end_trial_period_by_employee, end_trial_period_by_employer, family_care_leave, forced_leave, forced_termination_of_mandate, force_majeure, gross_misconduct_dismissal, internal_transfer, involuntary_termination, judicial_termination, location_change, merger_termination, mutual_early_termination, objective_termination, other_causes, other_suspension, professional_inadequacy_dismissal, resignation, resignation_or_termination, retirement, retirement_or_volontary_retirement, seasonal_unemployment, serious_misconduct_dismissal, simple_misconduct_dismissal, temporary_suspension_erte, termination, trial_period_failure, voluntary_resignation_of_mandate, voluntary_retirement

employee_number.description: The employee's internal identifier (employee ID) as set on their membership record.

employee_id_mappings.description: Employee ID mappings linking this employee to client partner identification codes

amendments.description: All non-virtual amendments ordered chronologically by start date

Planning.description: A planned or completed shift assigned to an employee, including both scheduled times and actual clock-in/out data.

id.description: Partner-scoped unique identifier for this shift

contract_id.description: Partner-scoped unique identifier of the contract this shift is linked to

date.description: Date of the shift (derived from starts_at)

starts_at.description: Planned start datetime of the shift

ends_at.description: Planned end datetime of the shift

real_starts_at.description: Actual start datetime of the shift (null if employee did not show up)

real_ends_at.description: Actual end datetime of the shift (null if employee did not show up)

real_break_duration.description: Actual break duration in minutes (null if employee did not show up)

note.description: Planned note attached to the shift

firstname.description: First name of the employee assigned to this shift

lastname.description: Last name of the employee assigned to this shift

location_id.description: Partner-scoped unique identifier for the location of this shift

location_name.description: Name of the location where this shift takes place

team_id.description: Partner-scoped unique identifier for the team this shift is assigned to

team_name.description: Name of the team this shift is assigned to

label_name.description: Name of the label/tag applied to this shift (e.g. a job type or activity)

events.description: Clock-in/clock-out events recorded for this shift (only included when explicitly requested)

event_type.description: Type of clock event (e.g. clock_in, clock_out)

recorded_at.description: Timestamp when the event was recorded

Rest.description: An absence or time-off event for an employee, such as paid leave, sick leave, or any other type of rest period.

id.description: Partner-scoped unique identifier for this rest/absence

contract_id.description: Partner-scoped unique identifier of the contract this rest belongs to

location_id.description: Partner-scoped unique identifier of the location this rest belongs to

rest_type.description: Type of absence/rest (e.g. paid_leave, sick_leave, unpaid_leave, etc.)

custom_value.description: Custom duration override in hours if the standard calculation is not applicable

Revenue.description: A revenue entry for a location on a specific date, containing both estimated and actual amounts.

location_id.description: Partner-scoped unique identifier for the location

estimated_amount.description: Estimated/forecasted revenue amount for this date and location

actual_amount.description: Actual recorded revenue amount for this date and location

automated_update.description: Whether this revenue entry was updated automatically via an integration (e.g. POS system)

EmployeeIdMappingInput.description: Request body for creating or updating an employee ID mapping between a membership and a client partner.

contract_id.description: Partner-scoped unique identifier of the original contract (not an amendment) — used to resolve the employee

identification_code.description: The identification code used by the client partner to reference this employee

RevenueInput.description: Request body for creating or updating a revenue entry for a location on a specific date.

location_id.description: Partner-scoped unique identifier for the location

amount.description: Actual revenue amount. At least one of amount or estimated_amount is required.

estimated_amount.description: Estimated/forecasted revenue amount. At least one of amount or estimated_amount is required.
